cell_type_model: transfected HEK293 cells; recombinant neurexin-1beta/neuroligin ectodomains; primary cortical and hippocampal neuronal synapse models

pathway_branch: NLGN2-NRXN1beta trans-synaptic adhesion -> inhibitory postsynaptic differentiation and synaptic transmission
limitations: NRXN1 splice-site 4 and neuroligin isoform context strongly affect affinity; the functional assays measure synapse organization rather than a defined intracellular NLGN2-specific kinase or adaptor relay. No terminal TF endpoint was measured.

cell_type_model: transfected HEK293 cells; recombinant NLGN3 and NRXN1beta ectodomains; primary cortical neurons
assay_or_perturbation: NRXN1beta binding/structural comparison; cell-aggregation and artificial-synapse differentiation assays; NLGN3 and splice-variant perturbations
relation_type: Direct NLGN3-NRXN1 adhesion is compatible with trans-synaptic synapse differentiation, but a pair-specific intracellular relay was not established
pathway_branch: NLGN3-NRXN1beta trans-synaptic adhesion -> excitatory/inhibitory synapse differentiation branch
limitations: Binding is splice- and isoform-dependent and the strongest functional study also identifies non-canonical PTPdelta-NLGN3 interactions; synapse-differentiation outputs are not evidence for a unique NRXN1 cytosolic pathway. No terminal TF endpoint was measured.

cell_type_model: NMBR-expressing epithelial or heterologous cells; primary mouse trigeminal ganglion neurons; goat granulosa cells

cell_type_model: recombinant human NMUR1/FM-3 in heterologous cells; rat smooth-muscle preparations; rat brain peptide discovery systems

pathway_branch: NMS-NMUR1 -> Gq/11-PLC-Ca2+ and Gi-adenylyl-cyclase inhibition -> MAPK/smooth-muscle or neuroendocrine output

pathway_branch: NMS-NMUR2 -> Gq/11-Ca2+ and Akt/ERK -> myometrial contraction/inflammatory preterm-labor branch

cell_type_model: recombinant NMUR1/FM-3 cells; rat fundus smooth muscle; mouse hippocampal neurons and Nmur1-competent ILC2s

cell_type_model: recombinant NMUR2/TGR-1 cells; rat fundus smooth muscle; primary mouse myometrial smooth muscle

relation_type: NMU activates NMUR2 with Gq/11-Ca2+, Gi-adenylyl-cyclase inhibition and MAPK outputs
pathway_branch: NMU-NMUR2 -> Gq/11-PLC-Ca2+ and Gi/MAPK -> central neuroendocrine or smooth-muscle contractile branch
limitations: The receptor-coupling study used recombinant receptors and NMU, while the tissue study adds an NMUR2-dependent inflammatory contractile context; branch strength varies with tissue and receptor abundance. No terminal TF endpoint was measured.

cell_type_model: Xenopus animal-cap Nodal reporter assays; transfected 293T cells; purified or Fc-tagged Nodal, ALK4/ACVR1B, ActRIIA/ACVR2A and Cripto systems

cell_type_model: Xenopus animal-cap and mammalian Nodal-responsive reporter systems; transfected cells; purified human Nodal receptor ectodomains
assay_or_perturbation: Nodal binding and receptor reconstitution; Cripto/TDGF1 dependence; ACVR2B/ActRIIB and ALK4/ACVR1B perturbation; SMAD2/3 phosphorylation and reporter assays

limitations: Human biochemical work also detects BMPRII and weaker ACTRIIB usage, and ACVR2A/B are partially redundant; the composite preserves the tested receptor family but should not be interpreted as an exclusive ACVR2B-only complex. No terminal TF endpoint was directly assigned.

cell_type_model: Nodal/Cripto-responsive Xenopus animal caps and transfected mammalian cells; purified receptor ectodomain systems

pathway_branch: Nodal-TDGF1-ACVR1B/ACVR2B -> receptor serine/threonine kinase -> SMAD2/3-SMAD4/FoxH1 developmental patterning branch
limitations: TDGF1/Cripto is a membrane-anchored coreceptor and the exact receptor stoichiometry varies by species and assay; downstream transcriptional outputs are developmental pathway readouts rather than a single terminal TF endpoint.

cell_type_model: primary hippocampal neurons; HEK293 heterologous synapse-formation cells; mouse brain synaptic preparations
